NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_MEDITATION.title: Meditation
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_MEDITATION.description:
Add 1 [gold]Chado[/gold] to your draw pile. End your turn.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold].
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_KARATE_STRAIGHT.title: Karate Straight
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_CHADO_CARD.title: Chado
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_CHADO_CARD.description:
At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Whenever you spend {Energy:energyIcons()}, this costs {Energy:energyIcons()} more this turn.
Discard this at {energyPrefix:energyIcons(3)}.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_CHOP_REDESIGN_V1.title: Chop
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_CHOP_REDESIGN_V1.descr: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {Karate:diff()} [gold]Karate[/gold]. Put this card on top of your draw pile.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_PALM_THRUST_REDESIGN_V: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to random enemies {Repeat:diff()} times.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_BURNING_STRIKE_REDESIG:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a [gold]Black Flame[/gold] to your draw pile.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_NINJA_WHIP_REDESIGN_V1:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the previous card you played this combat was an Attack, apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_IRON_SHIRT_REDESIGN_V1: Whenever you use Chado Breath, heal {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} HP.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_SWEEP_KICK_REDESIGN_V1: Whenever you gain additional Energy, gain {IfUpgraded:show:7|5} [gold]Block[/gold].
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_MURDER_FIST_REDESIGN_V: Spend 1 Tea Energy. Heal {IfUpgraded:show:13|10} HP. Exhaust.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_LOCK_ON_REDESIGN_V1.de: Chado Breath grants 2 additional Energy this turn. Retain. Exhaust.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_TORNADO_FIST_REDESIGN_: Return {Cards:diff()} card(s) from your discard pile to your hand. They gain Retain. Exhaust.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_BLOOD_TEARS_REDESIGN_V: Scry {Cards:diff()}. Cards in your hand gain Retain this turn. Draw {NextDraw:diff()} additional cards next turn.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_BACK_BRIDGE_REDESIGN_V: Scry {Cards:diff()}. Whenever you Scry, draw 1 card.
Before you play your next Attack, gain {IfUpgraded:show:5|3} temporary Strength.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_CONTRAPTION_REDESIGN_V: Whenever you play a card this turn, gain 1 temporary Strength.
Gain {IfUpgraded:show:4|2} Strength until the start of your next turn.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_EVADE_REDESIGN_V1.desc: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Gain {Strength:diff()} Strength.
Whenever your draw pile is shuffled, gain {IfUpgraded:show:12|8} Block.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_HALF_MOON_COMPASS_KICK: Gain 1 Shuriken Stock for each card already played this turn.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_IMPURE_FLAME_REDESIGN_: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Block is not removed at the start of your turn. Repeat.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_IYA_IRON_SLASH_WAVE_RE: Gain {Block:diff()} Block now and at the start of the next two turns. This card is affected by both Dexterity and Strength.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_MASOCHISTIC_BLISS_REDE: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has half HP or less, deal it again.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_MOMENTUM_REDESIGN_V1.d: The target takes {IfUpgraded:show:50|25}% more damage this turn. Exhaust.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_OPENING_GUARD_REDESIGN: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Next turn, gain temporary Strength equal to your remaining Block.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_READY_BLADE_REDESIGN_V: Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy. Discard 1 card. Retain. Exhaust.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_RIFFLE_REDESIGN_V1.des: Put 2 cards from your hand on top of your draw pile. Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy.
Every third Attack deals {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} times damage.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_SHIELD_FROM_NOTHING_RE: After the first card you play each turn, the next {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} card(s) with the same name cost 0 this turn.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_KILLING_INTENT_REDESIG: Gain {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} Tea Energy. Draw 1 card. Innate. Exhaust.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_NARAKU_RECOVERY_REDESI: Reduce the cost of cards in your hand to no more than 1 this turn. Exhaust.
Gain {PerCard:diff()} Block for each card in your hand.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_BANG_BANG_FIST_REDESIG: Choose a card from your draw pile, discard pile, or hand. Put it into your hand and give it Retain.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_BEAT_PEOPLE_CHADO_REDE: At the end of your turn, choose a card in your hand to gain Retain.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_BLADES_COME_REDESIGN_V: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies X times. If X is at least 4, deal {ThresholdDamage:diff()} each time instead.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_CLANK_DRINK_TEA_REDESI: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Strength affects this card {IfUpgraded:show:8|4} times.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_FOOTWORK_REDESIGN_V1.d: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Strength:diff()} Strength. Apply 1 Vulnerable to yourself.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_HELL_TORNADO_REDESIGN_: Gain 4 Shuriken Stock. Shuriken Stock deals 3 additional damage.
Gain {IfUpgraded:show:5|4} Shuriken Stock. Whenever Stock is consumed, gain {IfUpgraded:show:4|3} Stock.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_KARATE_FINISH_REDESIGN: Shuffle your discard pile into your draw pile. Scry {Cards:diff()}. Draw {NextDraw:diff()} additional cards next turn. Exhaust.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_KARATE_ROLLING_STONE_R: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If the next damage is not fully blocked, apply 3 Weak and 3 Vulnerable to ALL enemies. Retain. Exhaust.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_OMNIDIRECTIONAL_THROW_: Reduce the next {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} instance(s) of damage above 12 that you take to 0. Exhaust.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_RECYCLE_REDESIGN_V1.de: If the target has less than {Threshold:diff()} HP, kill it.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_RED_BLACK_FLAME_REDESI: Stun an enemy. Retain your hand this turn. Innate. Ethereal. Exhaust.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_REDOUBLE_REDESIGN_V1.d: Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP. Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy and draw {Cards:diff()} cards. At the start of each turn, lose 3 HP.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_SENCHA_STORM_REDESIGN_: Give a non-Power card Repeat. Its cost cannot be reduced below 1. Exhaust.
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_REPEAT_SWEEP_REDESIGN_: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Draw {Cards}. [gold]Repeat[/gold].
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_RETAIN_GUARD_REDESIGN_: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Give a card in your hand [gold]Retain[/gold].
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_SHURIKEN_VOLLEY_REDESI: Deal {Damage} damage to all enemies. Gain {Stock:diff()} [gold]Shuriken Stock[/gold].
NINJA_SLAYER_CARD_FLOWING_GUARD_REDESIGN: [gold]Retain[/gold]. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Whenever you play a card this turn, gain {PerCardBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
